note: Rejudged 2026-10-22 by independent route-policy auditor. RFC 9012 Section 11: "In addition, any BGP speaker that understands the attribute MUST be able to filter the attribute from outgoing BGP UPDATE messages." "This filtering SHOULD be possible on a per-BGP-session basis." This row owns the latter per-session SHOULD, not the outgoing-capability MUST, EBGP defaults, ingress filtering or dataplane. Read both current tagged tests TestRFC9012TunnelFilterSelectedSession and TestRFC9012TunnelFilterDoesNotAffectOtherSession, plus teSessionFilterRoundTrip, teSessionFilterTransport.CallFilterUpdate, teSessionFilterAssertBody and teSessionFilterDownstream in reactor/rfc9012_session_filter_test.go. The fixture transforms the actual raw request by removing only attribute 23, rather than returning precomputed output. Each round sends one received/cached UPDATE to two independently configured session writers, swaps which destination filters, asserts exactly one written UPDATE, exact attribute removal/preservation and unrelated encodings (with mandatory IBGP LOCAL_PREF), unchanged NLRI/withdrawals, one downstream production Session.processMessage dispatch with unchanged output, and original/cache immutability. Producers: filter_chain.go::PolicyFilterChain honors a raw modification and FinalAccept; filter_ordered.go::runEgressPolicyChainASN4 returns wireOverride; reactor_api_forward.go::forwardUpdateSection selects each snapshot exportPolicy and consumes the override for that destination only. The cutover replaces only the export filter value with typed Policy plus FinalAccept and renames the mutation comment; transformations and assertions are preserved. Retain enforced with the original unit-session/simulated-plugin-transport evidence boundary, not live daemon/TCP/FRR evidence. Old native record metadata is not a new observation; renewal and stamping remain parent-owned.
